The '''2007–08 season''' was '''[[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol]]''''s 77th season in [[La Liga]]. This article lists all matches that the club played in the 2007–08 season, and also shows statistics of the club's players. [[bwin|Bwin.com]] became the new kit sponsor.
